definitions.legacy_semantic_size_bytes: record.details.size_bytes read by numeric_export.py; currently populated only on non-projected document record, never on the 9 semantic node kinds
definitions.projected_json_storage_bytes: canonical UTF-8 JSON serialization size of the evidence record; wire/storage cost only, forbidden as a PDF object size feature
definitions.stream_raw_payload_bytes: record.details.raw_bytes encoded stream body byte length on StreamObject-backed nodes; excludes obj/endobj wrapper and dictionary header
definitions.verified_physical_declaration_span_bytes: half-open [byte_start, byte_end) of original-space confirmed raw_forensic indirect declaration joined strictly on (pypdf non-repaired backend, object_number, generation, verified header byte_offset_start)

structural_metric_definitions.kept_disconnected_from_catalog_by_cap: retained nodes directed-reachable from a catalog node in the eligible graph before cap that lose directed reachability from any retained catalog node after cap
structural_metric_definitions.kept_fragmentation_wcc_gain: wcc_after_cap minus the number of pre-cap eligible WCCs containing at least one retained node; strictly >= 0 and isolates splitting of retained subgraphs from deletion of >=200 components
structural_metric_definitions.newly_isolated_kept_nodes: retained nodes (< node_cap) with total eligible degree > 0 before cap and total retained degree == 0 after cap
structural_metric_definitions.newly_orphaned_kept_nodes: retained non-catalog nodes (< node_cap) with eligible in-degree > 0 before cap and retained in-degree == 0 after cap (flips model feature is_orphan from 0 to 1)
structural_metric_definitions.wcc_delta: wcc_after_cap minus wcc_before_cap across the full eligible vs retained node sets
